_about: The ordered steps Word takes for a missing font name (resolve.ts substituteFor interprets this table). Each step applies when every predicate of `when` holds (charset: fontTable w:charset equals; altName: a fontTable altName other than the name itself is present / absent; name / nameNot: the NFKC lower-cased name matches / does not match a regex source or a ref to a pattern of resolve.ts; altNameNot: the altName's key does not match; arabicSig: the w:sig covers the Arabic code page and the charset is not B2). `target` is a face, the altName, a choice by w:family (roman / none / else), a choice by the PANOSE serif byte (sans / else), or the name-keyed rows of substitutions.json. `behavioural` marks a rule Word applies on purpose (ResolvedFace.exception) as opposed to following the document's altName or the Calibri / Cambria fallback. `rule` is the SubstituteRule label the renderer reads from ResolvedFace.rules.

source.probe: a Hangul-charset entry substitutes Malgun Gothic wholesale, Batang when w:family is roman; PANOSE and the name's script do not matter
a Shift-JIS charset entry without altName lays out in Yu Gothic
missing Noto / Source Han KR faces go Malgun Gothic under a sans PANOSE, Batang otherwise
a missing Arabic name follows its altName before the Times New Roman rule (altName Arial laid out in Arial)
a 36 pt Arabic-named heading whose sig covers the Arabic code page came back ArialMT; the cloud faces keep their own metrics
a Hiragino / HG name with an altName follows it (altName Cambria came back Cambria, not Yu Gothic)
Word's name-keyed substitutions (name-prefix table, script clones, Han / Thai / Tamil / Arabic families), each row with its own probe
a missing name follows its fontTable altName in every slot and is drawn wholesale
two Latin-charset Arabic sans families whose sig covers the Arabic code page came back ArialMT in two documents; Arabic charset (B2) entries keep the Times New Roman rule
hangul-named faces go to Batang whatever the PANOSE says (sans, serif and absent PANOSE all Batang); only charset 81 reaches Malgun
Cambria for no fontTable entry or a w:family roman entry, Calibri for every other entry; PANOSE, charset and the sig code pages do not take part (probes 2026-10-22, 2026-11-08)
